summary: Iteration 76 — FRONTEND ONLY verification of (1) Notification Settings, (2) five-stage Order Tracking, (3) filter tabs across buyer/vendor/admin. All CORE flows pass end-to-end. Buyer /notification-settings renders exactly 4 rows (orders, chats, offers, login_alerts) — the vendor-only `notif-row-vendor_new_order` is correctly absent, all switches visually ON. Toggling `notif-switch-offers` off + reload keeps it off, toggling back on + reload keeps it on (API round-trip confirmed via network). Profile → 'Notifications' link (testID profile-notifications-link) is present and routes to /notification-settings. Vendor (testvendor@test.com) sees FIVE rows including notif-row-vendor_new_order; toggle+reload persistence verified. Order tracking: a fresh COD-style order (id d2d7eb77-…) was walked by the vendor through EXACTLY four next-stage clicks — button labels progressed 'Confirm order → Mark shipped → Out for delivery → Mark delivered' and after the fourth click the [data-testid=vnext-<id>] element vanished; the vendor card status pill reads DELIVERED. Buyer /orders card shows FIVE progress dots with the live line `order-track-now-<id>` = 'Delivered · Sep 11, 1:52 AM · by Test Shop'. The invoice modal `order-timeline` lists all five stages with a real timestamp AND '· Test Shop' as the who-moved-it name for every stage after Placed (which correctly has no by_name because the customer placed it). Timeline pre-walk: 'Placed Sep 11, 1:41 AM · Confirmed Pending · Shipped Pending · On the way Pending · Delivered Pending' (dots+labels for all 5 stages). Filter tabs: vendor /vendor/orders has all 5 new stages (`vorder-tab-{all,placed,confirmed,shipped,out_for_delivery,delivered,cancelled}`); admin /admin/orders has all 5 (`order-tab-{all,placed,confirmed,shipped,out_for_delivery,delivered,cancelled}`). BUYER /orders filter strip is MISSING two new stages — only `order-filter-{all,placed,shipped,delivered,cancelled}` is rendered; `confirmed` and `out_for_delivery` filter chips are absent even though the underlying order status_history stamps them and the card dots render them. No red-box errors, no blank screens on /orders, /notification-settings, /vendor/orders, /admin/orders. Only warnings observed are the pre-known web-only shadow*/expo-notifications/pointerEvents ones.

Should be [\"all\", \"placed\", \"confirmed\", \"shipped\", \"out_for_delivery\", \"delivered\", \"cancelled\"] to match the review request 'status filter tabs include the new stages (Confirmed / On the way where applicable)'.
